mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the breathing chest was most worthwhile because it brought ventilation, gas exchange and circulation together in one picture.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the thin lining felt less informative on its own; its contribution became clearer after the capillary mesh was added.

surprise.text: The shrinking oxygen arrows showed why blood flow alone cannot sustain oxygen transfer when the air is not renewed.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary. The item descriptions and results made each connection plausible, although some steps were predictable.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter: I am curious how the completed circulation connects to other body systems, although the straightforward sequence leaves limited room for decisions.
